title: Hugging Face releases LFM3 generation of Liquid Foundation Models
excerpt: The new 2B parameter range brings text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models onto a shared backbone.
bodyHtml:
Hugging Face published an announcement on October 27, 2026, regarding the launch of LFM3, its new generation of Liquid Foundation Models built to serve as a starting point for specialized intelligence. The release integrates text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models onto a single shared backbone within the 2B parameter range.

The LFM3-1.7B-Base model incorporates a tri-hybrid layer mix consisting of 13 gated short convolutions, 5 sliding-window attention layers with a 256-token window, and 6 global attention layers. It was pre-trained on 22T tokens using a 128K vocabulary.

Every LFM3 model branches from the LFM3-1.7B-Base. The family includes six models designed for edge deployment, fine-tuning on a single GPU, and various modalities such as vision, audio, and decision tasks.
